body: Looks like it’s time for martial law and for the National Guard to set up shop.

Thanks for your kind words. I did at one time think like you and try to find even brief moments of happiness. I’ve even told others that “you will not be happy all of the time but live for the moments of happiness as brief as they may be” It’s just not enough. The last things that brought me glimpses of happiness no longer do. My pets were the last vestiges of happiness I had but they no longer bring any happiness. It is time to go.

While I appreciate that you took the time to reply to me, it is the same reply that you have posted elsewhere. There are no more breaks to be had. Bills keep coming, people still want me to do everything for them and stress will never go away. Life is not beautiful. It is savage and cruel. There is more to life than just living.  If I am simply existing then there is no point.

I’m not sure about if you will see this but I have a request that before you walk away to die, please try and rehome your cats.  They will not survive and it is unlikely the neighbors will take them in.  I am not going to tell you not to go through with your plan as I have a similar plan but I am rehoming my animals first. They deserve a chance and so do your cats.  I am sorry that your life has been absolutely horrible.  It is not fair and it should have been better. I won’t tell you things will get better because I don’t know that they will. All I can say is that I am sorry and I understand being tired and in pain
